facts.fact: Lusa reports that NOSi is a public company created to look after the State's technology area, and that it occupies a floor of the Techpark building in Praia.

CPV.note: No data centre stated as for hire.
Tax benefits of a technology free zone only mentioned; no startup law, label or fund.

facts.fact: Lusa quotes the Techpark board chair that the public technology park in Praia has five buildings, 23 companies from seven nationalities and 400 workers present, ahead of its 5 and 6 May 2025 openings.
